name: WIN Semiconductors Corp.
summary: WIN Semiconductors Corp., established in 1999 and headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, is primarily engaged in the research, development, manufacturing, and global distribution of gallium arsenide (GaAs) wafers. The company serves markets across Taiwan, Asia, the Americas, and Europe. Its key semiconductor products include GaAs monolithic microwave integrated circuits (MMICs) and radio frequency integrated circuits (RFICs). In addition to its core semiconductor offerings, WIN Semiconductors provides a range of related services, suchalling foundry capabilities, testing, design support, high-frequency packaging, and final product testing. The company also maintains a diverse portfolio of other ventures, including: The development and commercialization of technology for hog farming. The research, production, and sale of high-density gene chips, biochip optical readers, and micro-electrophoresis analyzers. The development and trade of farm animal feed. The creation and sale of diagnostic tools for endometrial cancer. Information software services. Biotechnology and pharmaceutical testing, along with biotech research and development. Furthermore, WIN Semiconductors manages its own investment, logistics, and marketing operations.
